name: operon-os-sandbox
description: OS-level command sandboxing for the LocalMachine: every Machine.run is wrapped in the platform sandbox (macOS Seatbelt / Linux bubblewrap, via @anthropic-ai/sandbox-runtime) with workspace-scoped write access, domain-allowlist networking, and sandbox-denial annotation on stderr. Unsupported platforms and missing dependencies degrade to a plain LocalMachine.

scripts.test: for f in src/test/e2e*.ts; do echo "\n▶ $f"; node --experimental-strip-types --no-warnings "$f" || exit 1; done
